newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL MADRID BEAT LOGRONES TO STAY CLEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL MADRID BEAT LOGRONES TO STAY CLEAR.

text.p: Real Madrid remained top of the Spanish first division on Sunday with a comfortable 2-0 victory at struggling Logrones.

Fabio Capello's side stayed nine points ahead of Real Betis, who snatched an injury-time winner at Real Sociedad to jump into second place over Barcelona, whose game at Atletico Madrid kicked off late.
Real Madrid went ahead in the first half when Victor Sanchez pounced on a defensive error and Raul Gonzalez took advantage of another blunder to wrap up the game after the break.
Zaragoza climbed out of danger with a 2-0 home win over Hercules, while surprise outfit Valladolid continued their UEFA Cup challenge with a 2-1 win at Sporting Gijon which left them sixth.
